Text.Value: Humans look so strange without their clothes.
Running around without clothes doesn't seem to be the smartest thing to do in an environment like this.
Sadly, I'll never know the exhilaration of being nude.
People look so strange without their clothes.
You certainly know your way around a workbench.
This should prove interesting... I wonder what you'll build next.
It's always fascinating watching you create.
I'm not certain your aware of this, but robots were never meant to swim.
While I don't normally shy away from water, it isn't exactly my first choice for travel.
Perhaps we could find a way around this body of water instead?
Doing a bit of light reading to pass the time?
That would be more efficient if it was a holotape.
Learn anything interesting, sir?
Learn anything interesting, ma'am?
Those rads are getting the better of you. Better take some Radaway.
You're not looking well... I think you've soaked too many rads.
According to my rad counter, you should visit a doctor as soon as possible.
My rad counter is spiking. We may want to move.
Being non-organic, these rads won't affect me. You, that's a different story.
If we keep standing in this radiation, you're going to get sick.
Maybe I could carry some of that for you?
You might want to drop some of those things you're carrying.
Carrying all that weight is simply slowing you down.
Proceed with caution, this area may be occupied.
I don't think we're supposed to be here.
I hope you know what you're doing.
What a clever way to bypass that lock.
I wonder what the inventor of the bobby pin would think of its new primary use in the Commonwealth.
Still using bobby pins to open those locks? How crude.
Hopefully the reward will be worth all that effort.
Adding a bit more punch to your weapon, sir?
Adding a bit more punch to your weapon, ma'am?
Increasing your firepower should proportionally increase your chances of survival.
Well done. Like watching an artist at work.
That should afford you better protection.
Making some changes to your armor? Clever.
I'm pleased with anything that keeps you alive longer.
Remind you of brighter days, sir?
Remind you of brighter days, ma'am?
That's a museum quality piece.
The past yields such interesting finds.
Impressive. I wasn't aware such a thing even existed.
Very nice. That should tip the odds in our favor.
You're quite lucky to find one of those, they're quite rare.
May as well take what we can... they won't be needing those items any longer.
Perhaps next time we should scout for a safer way down.
That was foolish! Are you damaged?
I hope you don't expect me to jump down like that!
Impressive. Couldn't have done it better myself.
You certainly have a knack for adapting to technology.
I often forget people need to use the keyboard to access a terminal.
Using a keyboard? How quaint.
That vehicle looks dangerous. I wish you luck, sir.
That vehicle looks dangerous. I wish you luck, ma'am.
I'm afraid I'm not equipped to travel on a vertibird. I'll catch up with you later.
I'm going to stick to the ground. We'll meet up soon.
Unfortunately, a vertibird cannot properly accommodate me for air travel. I'll meet you at your destination.
Now you'll know a bit more how I feel being encased in a metal shell.
That suit should tip the balance of things in our favor.
Decided to play tin soldier, sir?
That power armor will provide adequate protection.
I hope you have additional fusion cores to spare.
Decided to play tin soldier, ma'am?
You certain you wish to leave that behind?
Leaving that here would be a waste.
You're dropping that? Strange... it seems quite useful to me.
Are you certain that's wise? Alcohol will likely impair your capabilities.
What was that expression? "Down the hatch?"
I'm not equipped to imbibe alcoholic substances, so I'm afraid you'll have to drink alone, sir.
I'm not equipped to imbibe alcoholic substances, so I'm afraid you'll have to drink alone, ma'am.
What exactly are you firing at?
Is this really the best place to be firing your weapon?
I'd suggest you stop doing that before you hurt someone.
Were you aware that repeated chem use can cause serious health issues?
According to my files, potential side effects of that chem are: nausea, vomiting and diarrhea... or are you attempting the trifecta?
I trust that won't end up slowing us down.
I'm concerned that those chems appear to be taking a serious toll on your body, sir.
I'm concerned that those chems appear to be taking a serious toll on your body, ma'am.
I hope you're aware that chem addiction comes at a terrible cost.
You're not looking well. Perhaps you should stop using so many chems.
I'll cover you, sir!
I'll cover you, ma'am!
Time to end this!
Resistance is futile!
Violence protocols engaged!
Engaging hostile target!
Never fear, sir... we'll emerge victorious!
Never fear, ma'am... we'll emerge victorious!
What a surprisingly pleasant day. Perhaps it will lift our spirits.
Evening is drawing near. Perhaps we should seek shelter?
It's almost sunrise. I trust you'll have another pleasant day.
We've survived another night. A triumph, I think.
It's a rather pleasant evening, wouldn't you say?
Don't worry, my ocular sensors are well suited for travel at night.
What a surprisingly pleasant day. Perhaps it will lift your spirits.
Oh my, it's raining again. Fortunately, it won't effect my electronics.
We have the entire Commonwealth to explore. Where should we go next?
There's so much ground to cover in the Commonwealth. Where should we go next?
Whatever it is we're out here looking for, I'm certain we'll find it soon.
It's astounding how much we still have to discover out here.
Would you like me to go with you?

Responses.ScriptNotes: Ada: Intro line for pick up scene to become a follower.

Text.Value: A pleasure to see you again, sir. Are you ready to depart?
A pleasure to see you again, ma'am. Are you ready to depart?
Identity confirmed. This unit is ready to serve.
Engaging target!
Weapons armed!
Threat detected!
Attack mode engaged!
Hostility mode activated!
Priority mission: destroy hostile!
Powering up weapons!
Weapon systems online!
Hostile in range!
Danger! Danger!
Opening fire!
Let's get this done!
Target's in range!
We've got company!
Take them down!
Let me have this one!
Let's take them out!
Safety's off!
Powering weapons!
Get 'em, sir!
Get 'em, ma'am!
Target eliminated.
Target destroyed.
Hostile neutralized.
Alert status: green.
Adversary exterminated.
Threat annihilated.
Threat level: zero.
Powering down weapons.
Hostility mode suspended.
Combat systems returning to standby.
Target down.
That takes care of that.
Not much of a threat after all.
That was amusingly simple.
Hopefully, that's the last of them.
Good riddance.
Are you injured, sir?
Are you injured, ma'am?
Powering down weapons, sir.
Powering down weapons, ma'am.
Well done, sir!
Well done, ma'am!
